title: NscRequest
description: Requester-to-MESH NSC request data elements for standard identity-based and SSN-only verification methods.

standardIdentityVerificationRequest.description: NSC request data elements for the standard identity-based verification method.

personSocialSecurityNumber.description: Full 9-digit Social Security Number or last 4 digits only.

personGivenName.description: Student's first name sent in request. Use FNU or NFN when no first name is available.

personMiddleName.description: Student's full middle name or middle initial.

personSurName.description: Student's last name sent in request.

previousNames.description: Zero to five sets of prior names.

personBirthDate.description: Student's birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

asOfDate.description: Enrollment records are returned as if the request was placed on this date, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

termsAcceptedIndicator.description: Indicates that the Requester has accepted the applicable Clearinghouse terms and conditions for the NSC query.

ssnOnlyVerificationRequest.description: NSC request data elements for the SSN-only verification method.

personSocialSecurityNumber.description: Full 9-digit Social Security Number used as the primary identifier for SSN-only verification.

asOfDate.description: Enrollment records are returned as if the request was submitted on this date, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

termsAcceptedIndicator.description: Indicates that the Requester has accepted the applicable Clearinghouse terms and conditions for the NSC query.
